name: B-DNA helical constraints
summary: From X-ray patterns of wet DNA fibres, Franklin and Gosling inferred in 1953 a probable two-chain helix with phosphates outside, key measurements for solving DNA's structure.
description: Franklin and Gosling inferred a probable helix, approximately 34 Å repeat and 20 Å diameter, with exterior phosphates and a probable two-chain unit.
